# Canonical graph byte oracles

`g1.json`, `g2.json`, and `g3.json` are the exact one-line JCS byte strings authored
in sections 56.1, 56.2, and 56.3 of the maintainer-supplied
`NEXUS_CEREBRI_INTELLIGENCE_ARCHITECTURE_v1.2.6_CONSOLIDATED (2).md`.
Authority SHA-256: `007fdbab8630ecd8119215f329d7e9e36d73076de1bef885f1055c859da2edab`.
Files contain no BOM or trailing newline. They must not be regenerated by the implementation.

`evaluation_graph.rs` independently constructs their source graphs and compares both
exact bytes and SHA-256 with the domain prefix
`nexus-cerebri:canonical-graph-serialization:v1\0`:

| Vector | Expected digest |
| --- | --- |
| G1 | `623d6faba158e6e1cefeefd261bf1dcd85936319ac3243f2766bb7f8db20e9cf` |
| G2 | `9788f47276e36901ce5a827f87bac2f9886ca97aae364d150f33ac8dbe02703b` |
| G3 | `42b7ee4c83a8068476b40ca563c80f34ce8df25dc8922f6a9b65070c2f8dac8e` |

The graph-only oracle helper does not define BSF labeling. Complete external semantic
REF relations enter through the complete BaseScenario renderer in B.2.

## BaseScenario B1

`b1.json` is the exact external literal from section 56.4 of the same authority,
verified against that document: 2003 UTF-8 bytes, no BOM or trailing newline. Its
semantic source is constructed separately in `evaluation_scenario.rs`; production
serialization never generates the expected fixture.

Domain: `nexus-cerebri:base-scenario-fingerprint:v1\0` (a terminating NUL byte).
Expected digest: `9989e8381324dea03f300aec98ba28cfb4851a941eb8cd0f2e85682adb504b0c`.
